extracted.name: Indian mint sauce
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by Good Food member stevepoppitt and has not been tested by our team.
ingredient_lines: 1 large pot of natural yogurt (full or low-fat)
2 tbsp ready-made mint sauce from a jar
instruction_lines: Put all the ingredients into a food blender.
Transfer to a dish and chill in the fridge.
Enjoy with any indian snack, starter or curry.
